tools.name: evidence-intelligence_file-hash-manifest
tools.description: Hash uploaded evidence bytes locally with md5, sha1, sha256, and sha512. Hash matches verify cryptographic integrity only, not factual authenticity. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/file-hash-manifest. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_metadata-extract
tools.description: Extract container metadata from uploaded files locally. Missing EXIF or GPS fields are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/metadata-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_c2pa-provenance-verify
tools.description: Look for local C2PA/JUMBF markers in uploaded bytes. Marker presence is not a factual authenticity determination. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/c2pa-provenance-verify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_chain-of-custody-build
tools.description: Order supplied custody events per evidence id and compare optional hashAfter values to current sha256 digests. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/chain-of-custody-build. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_image-source-timeline-build
tools.description: Combine caller-supplied capture times, local EXIF timestamps, and custody events into an image timeline. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/image-source-timeline-build. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_video-keyframe-extract
tools.description: Inspect local video container metadata and hash caller-supplied keyframe image files. Frames are not decoded by external services. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/video-keyframe-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_visual-location-clue-extract
tools.description: Extract embedded GPS or location text clues from local image metadata. Missing coordinates are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/visual-location-clue-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_duplicate-cluster
tools.description: Cluster uploaded evidence files that share the same sha256 digest. Duplicates are cryptographic only. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/duplicate-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_integrity-recheck
tools.description: Compare current local hashes to caller-supplied expected digests. A match verifies cryptographic integrity only. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/evidence-intelligence/integrity-recheck. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: evidence-intelligence_forensic-report
tools.description: Aggregate hash, metadata, C2PA, custody, timeline, keyframe, location, duplicate, and integrity results. Distinguishes cryptographic integrity from factual authenticity.
